stages.name: INTAKE
stages.gate: identity, territory, target population and call reference are explicit

stages.name: CALL_INTELLIGENCE
stages.gate: eligibility, evaluator requirements and indicators are versioned

stages.name: RESEARCH_PLAN
stages.gate: questions are need-discovery questions, not solution confirmation prompts

stages.name: EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE
stages.gate: official-first, provenance retained, historical cutoff respected when applicable

stages.name: EVIDENCE_VALIDATION
stages.gate: material claims use admissible evidence; unresolved contradictions are preserved

stages.name: GAP_DETECTION
stages.gate: school/UAT-specific claims without direct evidence become gaps

stages.name: PRIMARY_RESEARCH
stages.gate: raw responses canonical; sample/coverage/missingness and population fit validated

stages.name: NEED_DISCOVERY
stages.gate: each priority need has an evidence chain; indicators/compliance cannot create needs

stages.name: NEED_RANKING
stages.gate: ranking exposes evidence confidence and applicability; unsupported needs cannot rank

stages.name: CAUSAL_MODEL
stages.gate: association is not represented as causality without support

stages.name: INTERVENTION_TRACEABILITY
stages.gate: Need -> Evidence -> Cause -> Intervention -> Output -> Result -> Indicator is explicit

stages.name: ADVERSARIAL_QA
stages.gate: zero critical failures and zero unwaived high failures

stages.name: PACKAGE
stages.gate: QA pass required; unresolved blocking gaps prevent narrative-ready status

determinism: Every stage output is canonical JSON and is hashable; rerun with identical inputs/rules/source snapshots must produce semantically identical output.
